sentences.text: Anaeromassilibacillus senegalensis was described from the stool of a one-year-old kwashiorkor patient in Senegal.
A later study of human faecal isolates referred to Anaeromassilibacillus senegalensis strain mt9 as a non-validly published genus name.
A 16S amplicon study of faecal samples reported that Anaeromassilibacillus decreased in Alzheimer disease compared with idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus.
